text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al- Sabah leaves hospital today (Thursday) after a sudden indisposition on Tuesday.
- Kuwait Airways Corp says it ran 1,000 flights in February.
- Real estate firms lead active trade at the Kuwait Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
- Parliament's legal affairs committee submits a bill on combating unemployment. The bill proposes that the government create a social security scheme for jobless Kuwaitis.

- Parliament Speaker Ahmad al-Saadoun rejects an invitation to Kuwaiti parliamentarians by an Iraqi trade union chief to discuss the issue of detainees. Kuwait says Iraq has held some 600 Kuwaitis since the 1990-91 Gulf War.
